reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer, so I would keep scrolling. The sachet is a nice idea for someone who forgets, but it is not enough to make me tap the yellow cart at that price.
objection: Why pay $30 for a month of magnesium when I can get a bigger bottle for $19 to $23? I have never heard of this brand and the launch price only lasts for the first box.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing the sachet fixing the exact problem of forgetting vitamins, with the price at $19.99 or less for the first box.
